{"id":"oe-bhi.1","title":"Initialize Turborepo Monorepo","description":"Initialize well-structured monorepo for organized code, fast builds, and shared packages.

## Tech Stack
- Runtime: Bun (package manager, test runner, script executor)
- Monorepo: Turborepo for build orchestration and caching
- Type Checking: tsgo (native Go TypeScript checker - 10x faster than tsc)
- Linting/Formatting: Biome (single tool replacing ESLint + Prettier)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Initialize Turborepo with Bun as package manager
- [ ] Create root package.json with workspaces configuration
- [ ] Create turbo.json with pipeline for build, test, lint, typecheck
- [ ] Set up apps/ directory structure (web, as2-server)
- [ ] Set up packages/ directory structure (edi-parser, backend, shared, ui, config)
- [ ] Configure Biome for linting and formatting (biome.json at root)
- [ ] Configure shared TypeScript config in @openedi/config (use tsgo for type checking)
- [ ] Configure shared Tailwind config in @openedi/config
- [ ] Verify bun install works from root
- [ ] Verify bun run build builds all packages in correct order
- [ ] Add .gitignore for node_modules, dist, .turbo, etc.
- [ ] Add README.md with setup instructions
- [ ] If tsgo (@typescript/native-preview) is unavailable, configure tsc as fallback

## Directory Structure
openedi/
├── turbo.json
├── package.json
├── bun.lockb
├── apps/
│   ├── web/           # @openedi/web
│   ├── as2-server/    # @openedi/as2-server
│   └── docs/          # @openedi/docs (optional)
├── packages/
│   ├── edi-parser/    # @openedi/edi-parser
│   ├── backend/       # @openedi/backend (Convex)
│   ├── shared/        # @openedi/shared
│   ├── ui/            # @openedi/ui
│   └── config/        # @openedi/config
└── tooling/
    ├── scripts/
    └── docker/","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"krgebis@gmail.com","created_at":"2026-01-31T03:47:22.701926321Z","created_by":"mayor","updated_at":"2026-01-31T03:47:22.701926321Z"}

{"id":"oe-bhi.4","title":"Initialize Convex Backend","description":"Convex backend for database and API stories.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Create packages/backend with Convex project
- [ ] Configure Convex schema with ALL tables (see Data Model below)
- [ ] Set up Convex Auth with email/password provider
- [ ] Create example query and mutation functions
- [ ] Link Convex to web app via environment variables
- [ ] Verify bun run --filter @openedi/backend convex dev works
- [ ] Add convex:check script for CI validation

## Data Model - Required Tables
1. users - email, name, role (admin|operator|viewer), authProvider, externalId, lastLoginAt
2. organizationKeys - name, publicCertificate, privateKeyRef, algorithm, validFrom/Until, isActive
3. tradingPartners - name, isaId, isaQualifier, as2Id, as2Url, publicCertificate, certificateChain[], mdnUrl, timezone, requireMtls, pinnedCertFingerprint, preferredEncryption, isTest, isActive
4. controlNumberSequences - partnerId, lastInterchange/Group/TransactionControlNumber
5. transactions - partnerId, type (940|945), direction, status (17 states), rawEdi, parsedJson, validationErrors[], as2MessageId, mdnStatus, relatedTransactionId, fulfillmentStatus
6. webhooks - url, authType, authCredentials, signingSecret, previousSigningSecret, transactionTypes[], partnerIds[], isActive
7. webhookDeliveries - transactionId, webhookId, deliveryId, status, attempts, lastAttemptAt, nextRetryAt, responseCode, responseBody, errorMessage
8. apiKeys - userId, keyHash, prefix, name, scopes[], expiresAt, lastUsedAt, isRevoked
9. idempotencyKeys - key, transactionId, payloadHash, expiresAt
10. as2Deliveries - transactionId, partnerId, messageId, status, attempts, maxAttempts, lastAttemptAt, nextRetryAt, mdnReceived, mdnPayload, errorMessage
11. apiUsageLog - apiKeyId, endpoint, method, statusCode, responseTimeMs, ipAddress, userAgent
12. auditLog - userId, action, resourceType, resourceId, details, ipAddress
13. deadLetterQueue - originalDeliveryId, deliveryType, transactionId, failureReason, payload, attempts, lastError, processedAt, resolution

## Required Indexes
- transactions: by_partner_created, by_status, by_as2_message_id, by_direction_created
- webhookDeliveries: by_next_retry, by_transaction, by_status
- apiKeys: by_key_hash, by_user
- idempotencyKeys: by_key, by_expires
- tradingPartners: by_isa_id, by_as2_id
- as2Deliveries: by_next_retry, by_message_id
- auditLog: by_created, by_resource

## Date/Time Conventions
- API/JSON: ISO 8601 with timezone (2025-01-30T12:00:00Z)
- EDI segments: YYMMDD or YYYYMMDD, HHMM for times
- Database storage: Unix epoch milliseconds (number)
- Timezone handling: All internal processing UTC; EDI dates use partner's configured timezone

## Logging Specification
- Format: JSON with timestamp, level, message, correlationId, service, extra
- Levels: debug, info, warn, error (configurable via LOG_LEVEL)
- Correlation ID: Pass AS2 Message-ID through entire request lifecycle
- Retention: 30 days (configurable)","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"krgebis@gmail.com","created_at":"2026-01-31T03:48:03.511000066Z","created_by":"mayor","updated_at":"2026-01-31T03:48:03.511000066Z"}

{"id":"oe-b70.2","title":"Parse EDI X12 Envelope (ISA/GS/ST)","description":"Parse X12 interchange envelopes to extract individual transactions from EDI files.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Parse ISA segment: sender/receiver IDs, date/time, control numbers
- [ ] Parse GS (Functional Group): functional ID, version
- [ ] Parse ST (Transaction Set): transaction type (940, 945)
- [ ] Parse SE/GE/IEA trailers: validate control number matching
- [ ] Handle segment terminators (read from ISA position 106, typically ~)
- [ ] Handle element/sub-element delimiters (from ISA; defaults * and >)
- [ ] Return structured envelope metadata separate from transaction content
- [ ] Support multiple GS/ST transaction sets within single ISA interchange (FR-14)

## Test Fixtures (packages/edi-parser/tests/fixtures/)
940-tpvision-sample.edi:
- senderQualifier: "ZZ", senderId: "TPVISION"
- interchangeControlNumber: "000018457" (ISA13)
- groupControlNumber: "70870662" (GS06)
- transactionControlNumber: "000018456" (ST02)

945-tpvision-sample.edi:
- senderQualifier: "08", senderId: "TPVUSA0001"
- interchangeControlNumber: "000033791" (ISA13)
- groupControlNumber: "33791" (GS06)
- transactionControlNumber: "0029" (ST02)

envelope-invalid-control-numbers.edi:
- Expected: CONTROL_NUMBER_MISMATCH when ISA13≠IEA02 or GS06≠GE02 or ST02≠SE02

## Edge Cases
- EDI files are ASCII by default
- Strip UTF-8 BOM if present
- Reject non-ASCII with validation error including character position
- Support Windows-1252 as fallback with ALLOW_WINDOWS_1252=true
- Auto-detect segment terminator: if unreadable from ISA pos 106, try ~ then \n
- Future-dated transactions: accept but flag with FUTURE_DATED_INTERCHANGE warning","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"krgebis@gmail.com","created_at":"2026-01-31T03:48:27.189412255Z","created_by":"mayor","updated_at":"2026-01-31T03:48:27.189412255Z"}

{"id":"oe-b70.3","title":"Parse EDI 940 Warehouse Shipping Order","description":"Parse 940 messages for warehouse shipping orders from trading partners.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Parse W05 (Shipping Order Identification):
  - Order status code (N=New, C=Change, D=Delete, R=Replace)
  - Depositor order number, master reference number
- [ ] Parse N1/N3/N4 loops for Ship-To, Bill-To, Warehouse, Depositor parties
- [ ] Parse N9 segments for reference codes:
  - JD=customer account, LU=warehouse location
  - SUB=product subdivision, LI=line item reference
- [ ] Parse G61 for contact info (name, phone, email)
- [ ] Parse G62 for dates (ship, delivery, cancel):
  - Handle multiple G62 with same qualifier as array
  - JSON uses plural names: requestedShipDates, cancelAfterDates
- [ ] Parse NTE for notes and special instructions
- [ ] Parse W66 for carrier details:
  - W6601: Freight Payment Method (CC=Collect, PP=Prepaid)
  - W6602: Transportation Method (M=Motor, R=Rail, A=Air)
  - W6603-W6609: reserved/empty
  - W6610: SCAC (e.g., "UNKN")
- [ ] Parse LX/W01 loops for line items:
  - Quantity, UPC, vendor part number, buyer catalog number
  - Note: LX numbers may be zero-padded (LX*000010) or not (LX*1); normalize to integers
- [ ] Parse N9/LI within LX loops for line item cross-references
- [ ] Parse N9/SUB within LX loops for product category/subdivision
- [ ] Parse G69 for item descriptions
- [ ] Parse W20 for packaging details (weight, volume)
- [ ] Parse W76 for order totals
- [ ] Validate against X12 004010 structure rules
- [ ] Return comprehensive validation errors with segment/element references","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"krgebis@gmail.com","created_at":"2026-01-31T03:48:41.718295825Z","created_by":"mayor","updated_at":"2026-01-31T03:48:41.718295825Z"}

{"id":"oe-b70.4","title":"Parse EDI 945 Warehouse Shipping Advice","description":"Parse inbound 945 messages for shipment confirmations from trading partners.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Parse W06 (Warehouse Shipment Identification):
  - Reporting code, shipment ID, dates, PO reference
- [ ] Parse N1/N3/N4 for Ship-From and Ship-To parties
- [ ] Parse N9 for reference codes:
  - BM=BOL, CN=PRO number, PT=pallet count
  - JD=customer code, LU=warehouse, AO=appointment number
  - LO=load/seal with datetime (N904=YYYYMMDD, N905=HHMMSS)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Parse W06 (Warehouse Shipment Identification):
  - Reporting code, shipment ID, dates, PO reference
- [ ] Parse N1/N3/N4 for Ship-From and Ship-To parties
- [ ] Parse N9 for reference codes:
  - BM=BOL, CN=PRO number, PT=pallet count
  - JD=customer code, LU=warehouse, AO=appointment number
  - LO=load/seal with datetime (N904=YYYYMMDD, N905=HHMMSS)
- [ ] Parse G62 for ship date and estimated delivery
- [ ] Parse W27 for carrier details:
  - W2701: Transportation Method (L=LTL, M=Motor, R=Rail)
  - W2702: SCAC/Routing (e.g., "WALM")
  - W2705: Freight Payment Method (CC=Collect, PP=Prepaid)
  - W2708: Equipment Number (trailer/container ID)
- [ ] Parse LX/MAN/W12 loops for carton-level detail
- [ ] Parse MAN segment (dual-qualifier structure):
  - MAN01: Mark Qualifier 1 (GM=SSCC-18)
  - MAN02: Mark Number 1 (SSCC-18 barcode value)
  - MAN04: Mark Qualifier 2 (CP=Carrier Package ID)
  - MAN05: Mark Number 2 (tracking number or "NA")

{"id":"oe-nyo.1","title":"AS2 Message Reception","description":"Receive EDI messages via AS2 from trading partners using existing EDI infrastructure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Implement AS2 HTTP endpoint at /as2/receive
- [ ] Parse AS2 headers (AS2-From, AS2-To, Message-ID, etc.)
- [ ] Decrypt S/MIME encrypted messages using private key
- [ ] Verify S/MIME signatures using partner's public certificate
- [ ] Support encryption: AES-128, AES-256 (preferred), Triple DES (legacy)
- [ ] Log deprecation warning for Triple DES; document migration timeline
- [ ] Support SHA256 signing (preferred); SHA1 for legacy with warning
- [ ] Extract EDI payload from MIME multipart message
- [ ] Store received message with full audit trail; if audit storage fails, return error MDN

## Duplicate Detection (FR-13)
- Duplicate AS2 Message-ID: Return MDN with processed/warning: duplicate-document
- Do not create duplicate transaction

## Payload Size Limits (FR-15, FR-16)
- AS2 payloads over 10MB: return HTTP 413 with error MDN
- Allocate maximum 256MB memory per AS2 request

## Error Handling
- Certificate validation failure: MDN with processed/error: authentication-failed
- Decryption failure: MDN with processed/error: decryption-failed, alert admin
- Signature verification failure: MDN with processed/error: integrity-check-failed

## Infrastructure Failures
- Convex backend unavailable: Return 503 with MDN requesting async retry; queue locally 5min TTL
- Audit storage failure: Do NOT process; return error MDN; alert admin immediately","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"krgebis@gmail.com","created_at":"2026-01-31T03:49:41.256226935Z","created_by":"mayor","updated_at":"2026-01-31T03:49:41.256226935Z"}

- [ ] Convex scheduled function: archive transactions older than 90 days
- [ ] Move archived transactions to warm storage with metadata in Convex
- [ ] Support retrieval via Archive Query API (oe-004.6)
- [ ] Compress archived data with gzip before storage
- [ ] Lazy loading in UI for large payloads (fetch on demand)

## Flows to Test
- [ ] Dashboard loads and displays correctly
- [ ] Transaction monitor shows transaction list (or empty state)
- [ ] Navigate to Trading Partners page
- [ ] Add a new trading partner (form submission)
- [ ] Navigate to Settings page
- [ ] Error dashboard displays correctly
- [ ] Submit a test EDI document (if backend is working)

## Playwright Test Structure
Each test should:
- Navigate to the page
- Verify key elements are visible
- Perform the action
- Verify the result

Example:

  await page.goto("/partners")
  await page.click("text=Add Partner")
  await page.fill("[name=name]", "Test Warehouse")
  await page.fill("[name=isaId]", "TESTWH01")
  await page.click("text=Save")
  await expect(page.getByText("Test Warehouse")).toBeVisible()
})
```

- [ ] At least 5 E2E tests created
- [ ] Tests pass locally: `bun run test:e2e`
- [ ] Tests cover core user flows

- [ ] Dashboard loads and displays correctly

- [ ] Navigate to Trading Partners page
- [ ] Add a new trading partner (form submission)
- [ ] Navigate to Settings page
- [ ] Error dashboard displays correctly
- [ ] Submit a test EDI document (if backend is working)

## Playwright Test Structure
Each test should:
- Navigate to the page
- Verify key elements are visible
- Perform the action
- Verify the result

Example:
```typescript
test("can add trading partner", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/partners")
  await page.click("text=Add Partner")
  await page.fill("[name=name]", "Test Warehouse")
  await page.fill("[name=isaId]", "TESTWH01")
  await page.click("text=Save")
  await expect(page.getByText("Test Warehouse")).toBeVisible()
})
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] At least 5 E2E tests created
- [ ] Tests pass locally: `bun run test:e2e`
- [ ] Tests cover core user flows

Send EDI messages to trading partners via AS2 to deliver generated EDI documents.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Sign outbound messages using our private key
- [ ] Encrypt using partner's public certificate (prefer AES-256, support 3DES for legacy)
- [ ] Set proper AS2 headers (AS2-From, AS2-To, Message-ID, etc.)
- [ ] Support async MDN request
- [ ] Handle MDN receipt and update message status
- [ ] Implement retry logic (see Retry Configuration)
- [ ] Require HTTPS for production (HTTP only with ALLOW_HTTP_AS2=true)
- [ ] Support mTLS via tradingPartners.requireMtls flag
- [ ] Support certificate pinning via tradingPartners.pinnedCertFingerprint

## Retry Configuration
- Max Attempts: 3 (AS2_MAX_RETRIES)
- Backoff: Exponential with jitter
  - Attempt 1 failure: wait 1s + random(0-500ms)
  - Attempt 2 failure: wait 2s + random(0-500ms)
  - Attempt 3 failure: wait 4s + random(0-500ms)
- Circuit breaker: 5 consecutive failures in 10min → pause 30min

## After Max Retries
1. Mark delivery as failed
2. Move to dead letter queue
3. Send alert notification (if configured)","status":"hooked","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","assignee":"openedi/crew/nux","owner":"krgebis@gmail.com","created_at":"2026-01-31T03:49:52.352912499Z","created_by":"mayor","updated_at":"2026-01-31T17:47:29.806738925Z"}

{"description":"## Objective

Rework E2E tests to use proper authentication instead of bypasses.

## Current Problems

1. **Auth bypass active**: `VITE_E2E_TEST_MODE=true` skips frontend auth
2. **Backend has NO auth**: Convex mutations don't check `ctx.auth` (security issue)
3. **Unauthenticated test client**: ConvexTestClient uses HTTP without tokens
4. **Tests aren't authentic**: Pass because backend accepts anonymous requests

## Required Changes

### Phase 1: Remove Auth Bypasses
- [ ] Remove `VITE_E2E_TEST_MODE` from `scripts/start-e2e-servers.sh`
- [ ] Remove `isE2ETestMode` bypass logic from `apps/web/src/routes/__root.tsx`
- [ ] Remove `testIgnore: ['**/auth.setup.ts']` from `playwright.config.ts`

### Phase 2: Implement Proper Auth Setup
- [ ] Create `tests/e2e/auth.setup.ts` with real login flow
- [ ] Configure Playwright projects for authenticated/unauthenticated tests
- [ ] Create test user credentials in Convex
- [ ] Use `storageState` for session persistence

### Phase 3: Add Backend Auth (Security Fix)
- [ ] Add `ctx.auth.getUserIdentity()` checks to Convex mutations
- [ ] Decide auth strategy: throw on unauth OR allow specific public endpoints
- [ ] Update `packages/backend/convex/tradingPartners.ts`
- [ ] Update `packages/backend/convex/transactions.ts`

### Phase 4: Update Test Fixtures
- [ ] Update `ConvexTestClient` to use authenticated client
- [ ] Create proper data seeding through authenticated mutations
- [ ] Ensure cleanup works with auth

## Files to Modify

```
apps/web/src/routes/__root.tsx          # Remove E2E bypass
apps/web/scripts/start-e2e-servers.sh   # Remove VITE_E2E_TEST_MODE
apps/web/playwright.config.ts           # Add auth project setup
apps/web/tests/e2e/auth.setup.ts        # NEW: Real auth flow
apps/web/tests/e2e/fixtures/convex-client.ts  # Auth tokens
packages/backend/convex/tradingPartners.ts    # Add auth checks
packages/backend/convex/transactions.ts       # Add auth checks
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Tests run with real authentication (no bypass)
- [ ] Backend mutations require authentication
- [ ] Test data is seeded through authenticated mutations
- [ ] All existing E2E tests pass with auth enabled
- [ ] Auth failure scenarios are tested
"}

{"description":"## Problem

After migration to Dolt, 6 doctor/maintenance checks still read `issues.jsonl` directly with **no Dolt-first alternative**. Since nothing exports Dolt data back to JSONL, these checks scan an empty or stale file and silently report all-clear.

## Affected checks

### gastown (internal/doctor/)
1. `misclassified_wisp_check.go:124` — `findMisclassifiedWisps` scans JSONL for wisps missing ephemeral flag
2. `ready.go:381` — `getWispIDs` reads JSONL to exclude wisps from `gt ready` output

### beads (cmd/bd/doctor/maintenance.go)
3. `CheckPersistentMolIssues` (line 210) — scans for mol- issues without ephemeral flag
4. `checkMisclassifiedWisps` (line 334) — same as gastown version
5. `CheckPatrolPollution` (line 422) — scans for patrol digest pollution
6. `getPatrolPollutionIDs` (line 525) — reads IDs for fix path

## Context

- The write side is gone: only `InitBeads` (creates empty file) and `createAgentBeadViaJSONL` (last-resort fallback) touch it
- `getGitActivity` in status.go is dead code that confirms this: 'Previously calculated from git log of issues.jsonl; now returns nil'
- Other checks like `patrol_check.go` and `wisp_check.go` already use Dolt-first with JSONL fallback — these 6 should follow the same pattern
- `bd repo sync` legitimately reads JSONL from other repos (cross-repo import) — that's fine

## Suggested fix

Port these 6 checks to query Dolt first (via `bd sql` or `bd mol` commands), falling back to JSONL only if the database is unavailable. Same pattern used by `checkStuckWispsDolt` and `countAbandonedWisps`."}

      .withIndex('by_email', q => q.eq('email', 'e2e-test@openedi.local'))

})

})
